name: The Palms Turks and Caicos
insider_take: This intimate all-suite resort on Grace Bay Beach offers barefoot luxury where conch bar culture meets sophisticated island living.
whats_special: The Palms sits on the world's #1 rated beach according to TripAdvisor, featuring powder-soft sand and impossibly turquoise waters. As one of only a few all-suite resorts on Grace Bay, every accommodation offers separate living areas and most include oceanfront terraces. The resort's intimate 72-suite scale ensures personalized service while the nearby conch bar phenomenon - a uniquely Turks and Caicos tradition of beachside rum shacks - adds authentic local flavor.
pro_tip: Book the conch bar crawl experience to sample the island's famous conch fritters and rum punches at legendary spots like Da Conch Shack, accessible by complimentary bike or a short walk along the beach.
dont_miss: The Thursday night conch bar at nearby Sibonné Beach Hotel features live rake-and-scrape music (the islands' traditional genre), while the resort's proximity to the coral reef system makes it prime territory for spotting JoJo, the famous wild bottlenose dolphin who's been greeting swimmers in these waters for over 30 years.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location on Grace Bay Beach
Spacious luxury suites with full kitchens and private balconies
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Remote island location requires flight connections
